name: map_tutorial_idle
about: sp_tutorial_1 at idle for sixty seconds, nothing scripted: the named NPCs run the programs their rows and the map's load wires give them. sentry2 (SetupPatrolType '999 2 FOLLOW_PATROL_PATH_WALK' + FollowPatrolPath at t+2.0/2.1) and monk_upstairs_podium ('999 1 ...' + 'pod_1..pod_5' at t0/t+0.1) walk SCHED_TROIKA_FOLLOW_PATROL_PATH_WALK (cai_basenpctroika/sched_troika_follow_patrol_path_walk.sch), one type-4 goal per point, arriving and stepping with TASK_NEXT_PATROL_POINT (0x102aa9e0 -> NextPoint 0x10307b80) — docs/vtmb/npc-ai/programs.md § 'Patrol paths, walked'. The patrollers' program has nothing on it that can fail with its nodes bound (0018 story 4: positional AIN binding), so neither fails a task. 0019/8's map smoke: 0 ensure / assert (not observable in the trace; the launcher's log summary carries them). The Society hub is out of the start's PVS: retail's normal and update laws stretch to 16 s there (lifecycle.md § 'The interval laws': !PVS x10 cap 16), so a patrol step can wait 16 s for its think; the deadlines carry that.
notes: The expectations are ordered, so the monk's arrivals are carried by patrol_monk_loop rather than interleaved here; the end probes and the nevers hold both patrollers. Other NPCs of the map are not held to 'no taskfail': retail's own interesting-place routes are refused and retried every 5.1-10 s (programs.md § 'The failed walk'), and the trace's never takes no count to tell that from a storm (harness gap). sentry2's taskfail is held only before its map wires (1.8 s): retail's Setup-then-Follow leaves the path empty for 0.1 s, and a think in that window fails TASK_GET_PATH_TO_PATROL_POINT with 0x1d. Restated 2026-10-04 (V3c integrator, Q-V13a): before its wires sentry2 (use_interesting) selects 0xff at its first think and competes with mercenary_upstairs for the same places; the loser draws a place with no graph node in reach (navigation-jump-links.md:157: the Society hub's nearest node is 8963-9429 units away in the exported graph) and retail answers TASK_GET_PATH_TO_INTERESTING_PLACE's refusal with TaskFail(0x0c) 'Don't have a route' once, then the _FAILED program waits 5.1-10 s (programs.md:207-220). So the pre-wire never excludes that one failure and still holds every other. Caveat: the docs do not confirm that the exported graph is the network retail loads; if it is not, this exclusion hides a divergence. V6 audit predecessor: explicit fresh-map action isolates this idle guard while shares_map allows a following record in the same process. Every original predicate and bound retained.
